scenario: `now()` returns the engine clock per LTIM.2.1.1/2.1.2 — in mock mode, `now()` tracks the mock clock. A rule gated on `now()` after the instant 5_s past the epoch — built `calendar.time(1970, 1, 1, 0, 0, 5)` ([LTIM.14.1]), because `now()` is a `Time` and a bare integer is not ([LTIM.5.5]) — should not fire at t=0 but fires after clock advances to 6_s. Pin: advance clock, pump — rule fires exactly once.
rules_ds:
import calendar

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

rule after_5_s:
    Sensor where now() > calendar.time(1970, 1, 1, 0, 0, 5)
->
    log info "time passed"
